none_fit.what: Two antithetic sentences joined with no connective at all (no waw and no 'but' in the Hebrew; opens_with is null). No link type fits an unconnected antithesis, so none was added.

cant_tell.what: The implied subjects of the participles in cl1 and cl3 ('one who') are not in the slot list
cant_tell.why: As in Pro.10.4, each is a relative pronoun whose referent is the person the enclosing clause describes. The parser gave no slot, so none was added.

cant_tell.what: Whether cl0 and cl2 form a 'descriptions' group
cant_tell.why: The kind needs consecutive 'the one who' clauses describing one referent. Here the two clauses describe different people (the gatherer and the sleeper), so the group is not added.
